senses.gloss: ह्यस्तनी imperfect tense; a term used by ancient grammarians for the affixes of the immediate past tense, but not comprising the present day, corresponding to the term लङ् of Panini. The term is found in the Katantra and Haima- candra grammars; cf. Kat. III. 1.23, 27; cf. Hema. III. 3.9.
